name: web-button-states-component-sheet-in-black-red-orange-and-grey
title: Button state sheet: primary, secondary, tertiary, error, warning, rounded, loading, disabled and with icon
whatItIs: A white board with a 3x3 grid of buttons: a black Primary, an outlined Secondary, a text Tertiary, a red Error, an orange Warning, a black pill Rounded, a grey Loading with a spinner, a grey Disabled and a black With Icon with a left arrow.
whatItMeans: Systematic and readable; each state is named and visually distinct.
techniques: Show every button state in one grid.
Use semantic colours for error and warning.
Use spinner and grey for loading and disabled.

vocabulary.definition: A variant such as primary, error or disabled.
A colour that signals meaning (red for error).
An icon showing progress inside a button.
